    Contact and booking — recording studio in Warsaw

    Want to book a session at our recording studio in Warsaw, reserve the rehearsal room or ask about equipment rental? Get in touch whichever way suits you and we’ll reply with available dates. Sanctum Sound brings recording, mixing and mastering, a rehearsal room, a podcast studio and equipment hire together at one address in Praga-Południe, so one message is enough to sort out everything you need.

    How to book

    Fill in the contact form on this page, call us on +48 881 238 684, message @sanctum_sound_studio on Instagram or email support@sanctum-sa.com. Let us know what you’d like to do — recording, mixing, a rehearsal, a podcast or rental — and which dates work for you.

    • Sanctum Sound, Aleja Stanów Zjednoczonych 67, 03-770 Warszawa (Praga-Południe)
    • Phone: +48 881 238 684

    How to get there

    The studio is on Aleja Stanów Zjednoczonych in Praga-Południe, a main road on the right bank of the Vistula that’s well served by city buses and trams. The easiest way to plan your trip from anywhere in Warsaw is Google Maps or the Jakdojade app — just enter our address. Bringing a lot of gear for a band session? Let us know when you book and we’ll help you plan the load-in.
